docs.title: datapack
docs.text: Lossless and visually-lossless compression of acquisition data (ephys, video, histology) with verification and manifests.

docs.title: Development
docs.text:
git clone https://github.com/MurineShiftWork/datapack.git
cd datapack
uv sync --extra dev
uv run pre-commit install --hook-type pre-commit --hook-type commit-msg
uv run pytest

docs.text:
uv sync --extra docs
uv run mkdocs serve
